methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective cohort 207 HSIL/HR-HPV patients comparing anti-HPV gel vs interferon gel post-LEEP. Baseline characteristics balanced. Outcomes measured systematically. Limitations: single-center, no randomization, blinding absent, selection bias risk.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Comparative cohort study directly informing postoperative adjuvant therapy selection for HSIL. Anti-HPV gel shows superior clinical efficacy, microecology restoration, reduced inflammation, lower recurrence (6.67% vs 16.67%). Directly relevant for clinical decision-making.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods describe treatment protocols, outcome measures, statistical analysis. Results systematically compare groups across multiple dimensions. Effect size analysis provided. Data availability not discussed.

novelty_literature.justification: Comparative evaluation of anti-HPV gel vs established interferon therapy. Novel product application but mechanism largely qualitative. Exploratory predictive model for recurrence adds limited novelty.

writing_presentation.justification: Clear Results section with table comparisons. Discussion contextualizes mechanisms and compares with prior studies. Comprehensive limitations acknowledged. Organization adequate.

key_strengths: Comprehensive multi-dimensional outcome assessment (clinical efficacy, microecology, inflammatory/immune markers, cell proliferation biomarkers)
Balanced baseline characteristics between groups despite lack of randomization
Exploratory predictive model for recurrence with reasonable discrimination (AUC 0.812)
key_concerns: Single-center retrospective non-randomized design introduces selection and measurement bias
No blinding of treatment or outcome assessor; potential performance/detection bias
Limited sample size (N=207) with short follow-up (6 months) insufficient for long-term recurrence assessment
Predictive model derived from same dataset requiring external validation
chief_reviewer.rationale: Comparative cohort demonstrating superiority of anti-HPV gel over interferon with comprehensive biomarker assessment. Non-randomized design and short follow-up limit strength. Tier 4 appropriate; prospective RCT needed for confirmation.
